title: 48 Hours in Lisbon
excerpt: A dreamy short-stay itinerary for golden viewpoints, beautiful dinners, and slow wandering.

blocks.body:
## Day 1
Arrive, settle into a central stay, and spend the afternoon walking between viewpoints. Save the evening for one atmospheric dinner and a slow return through the old streets.

## Day 2
Build the morning around coffee and a rooftop view, then leave space for neighborhoods that invite wandering more than scheduling.

title: A Soft Weekend in Puglia
excerpt: Where to stay, what to prioritize, and how to pace a short Puglian escape.

blocks.body:
## The mood of the trip
This guide is less about rushing between lists and more about creating the right feeling: sea air, warm stone, long lunches, and one memorable stay.
